crossRefs.note: But if you seek anything about other matters, it will be settled in the regular assembly.

translations.web: But if you seek anything about other matters, it will be settled in the regular assembly.
translations.bsb: But if you are seeking anything beyond this, it must be settled in a legal assembly.
translations.kjv: But if ye enquire any thing concerning other matters, it shall be determined in a lawful assembly.
translations.asv: But if ye seek anything about other matters, it shall be settled in the regular assembly.
